shots.focal_element: Green shield with a white padlock at frame centre, surrounded by three clusters of stylised white website wireframe cards
shots.transition_other: Website cards arrive with heavy motion blur (fly-in/settle) from the previous shot; the shot ends on a blurred fast push into the shield
shots.what_happens: Over VO w237-w248 ('Safeguard your AI visibility ... digital insurance policy'), overlapping website wireframe cards slide into three clusters around a central shield-and-lock icon, hold almost static on a dark vignetted backdrop, then the camera rushes into the shield with strong blur to hand off to the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Place an SVG shield+padlock at centre on a dark radial-vignette background, fly in three groups of two overlapping white browser-frame cards (gradient image block plus bar placeholders) from off-frame with motion blur and an ease-out settle, hold, then scale the whole scene ~4x into the shield with a directional blur over ~0.3s.

shots.focal_element: Recreated 'Website' monitoring dashboard card (KPI tiles plus charts), later overlaid by red-triangle issue alert chips
on_screen_text: Largest Contentful Paint takes too long
shots.typography: Clean geometric/grotesque sans (low-confidence guess: Inter-like). Dashboard title 'Website' medium weight, title case, large; widget labels small uppercase with slight positive tracking; KPI numerals large regular/medium weight. Alert chips use bold sentence-case text, two-line wraps, typed on character by character. Chart axis labels (Month 1-6, 0-3000 scales) and small legend text are too small to quote reliably and are omitted.
shots.what_happens: Coming out of the shield zoom, a white dashboard panel builds up piece by piece: title types in, KPI tiles count/fill (health bar, pages, issues, open incidents), then Page Changes bars grow, the Health Changes area line draws on, Issue Changes bars and a Type donut appear (w249-w258 'Conductor AI monitors your site 24-7, catching issues in real time'). From about 1:37 the dashboard fades back and seven white alert chips with red warning triangles pop in at scattered positions, each label typing on, to illustrate 'catching issues' (VO through w272).
shots.build_rebuild: Build a white dashboard card centred on a dark vignette, stagger-reveal four KPI tiles (typewriter title, count-up numbers, filling progress bar) then draw on bar, area-line and donut charts left-to-right; at the climax drop the dashboard opacity to ~30% and pop in seven scattered red-bordered alert chips with a warning-triangle icon, each with a typewriter label staggered ~80ms apart.

shots.focal_element: Central white article card titled 'Discovering Your Perfect Mechanical Keyboard: A Comprehensive Guide' with a green 'Conductor' tab, flanked by stacks of lorem-ipsum content cards
shots.transition_other: The alert/dashboard scene smears out with horizontal motion blur while the new article card is already typing in on top (whip-like blurred hand-off)

shots.what_happens: Over w274-w284 ('Our platform is built to handle the complexities of enterprise websites'), a Conductor-branded article card types in at centre while green-outlined lorem-ipsum content cards slide in and pile up on both sides, partially off-frame, suggesting the volume of enterprise content; the central card's body text streams in during the first second.

shots.focal_element: Heavily blurred white rounded label pill on the dark vignette background

shots.what_happens: A 0.33s bridge frame (silent gap after w295, just before w296 'Stop'): the 'Generic Content' pill sits out of focus at centre on the dark background, the start of a focus pull into the next scene.
